# Cloud Services Agreement (Bonterms-style)

These Cloud Service Terms ("Terms") apply to Customer's use of Vendor's
cloud-based software services ("Services") under the order form
("Cover Page") that incorporates these Terms by reference.

## 1. Definitions

Capitalized terms not otherwise defined herein have the meanings given in
the Cover Page. "Customer Data" means data Customer submits to the
Services. "Authorized Users" means employees and contractors of Customer
authorized to access the Services.

## 2. Service Access

Vendor grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to access
and use the Services for Customer's internal business purposes during
the Subscription Term.

## 3. Customer Data and Security

Vendor will (a) maintain industry-standard administrative, physical, and
technical safeguards designed to protect Customer Data, (b) process
Customer Data only as needed to provide the Services or as instructed by
Customer, and (c) not access Customer Data except as needed for support.

## 4. Fees and Payment

Customer will pay the fees specified on the Cover Page. Fees are
non-refundable except as expressly provided. Late payments accrue
interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum permitted by
law.

## 5. Warranties and Disclaimers

Vendor warrants that the Services will conform in material respects to

ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" AND VENDOR DISCLAIMS ALL OTHER WARRANTIES,
EXPRESS OR IMPLIED.

## 6. Limitation of Liability

EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR
WILLFUL MISCONDUCT, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT,
INCIDENTAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY
WILL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE IN THE TWELVE MONTHS
PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

## 7. Term and Termination

The Subscription Term is set forth on the Cover Page. Either party may
terminate for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days of
written notice. Upon termination, Customer's access to the Services
ends and Vendor will return or destroy Customer Data within sixty (60)
days.

## 8. Governing Law
